hints.title: Structural Copy-on-Write Proxies
hints.text: Producing an updated version of a nested structure while keeping untouched branches shared requires intercepting mutation attempts and cloning only the modified path.

hints.title: Proxy Wrapping and Lazy Cloning
hints.text: Wrap the root object in a Proxy that intercepts property accesses and mutations. When a mutation occurs, create a shallow copy of that node and bubble the modified clone up to the parent.

hints.title: Immutability Proxy Blueprint
hints.text: Define Immutable class with produce(mutator) method. In produce, create shadow copies along accessed paths using Proxy traps for get and set. Run mutator on proxy and return materialized updated clone.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: total size of object tree
complexity.notes: Produces a clean immutable snapshot containing mutator changes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct in-place modification mutates the original object reference, violating functional immutability.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Cloning preserves historical snapshot references safely.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understanding structural sharing principles and proxy-based draft mutations.
